parole.significato: drunk, inebriated, intoxicated as a result of excessive alcohol consumption
parole.testo: From escabiar (“to drink booze, get drunk”) from escabio (“booze”) from vernacular Italian scabio, scabi (“wine”), from Ligurian scabbio and Lombard scabbi.

parole.significato: given to boozing, drinking heavily; excessively consuming alcoholic beverages; frequently drunken, boozy, bibulous, sot…
parole.testo: From escabiar (“to drink booze, get drunk”) + -dor, from escabio (“booze”) from vernacular Italian scabio, scabi (“wine”), from Ligurian scabbio and Lombard scabbi.

parole.significato: to go drinking, boozing; tipple, imbibe to excess; to drink intoxicating alcoholic beverages like wine, beer, or liquor…
parole.testo: From escabio (“booze, boozy; booziness”) from vernacular Italian scabio, scabi (“wine”), from Ligurian scabbio and Lombard scabbi.

parole.significato: booze; drink; alcoholic beverage; bottle of wine, beer, or liquor
